title: Degreewise ordinary base tensor comparison
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, A and B commutative R-algebras, and M an A-module. Use the tensor product [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] and scalar extension [def-weil-module-base-change]. There exists a B-linear isomorphism B ⊗_R Res_R M ≅ Res_B ((A ⊗_R B) ⊗_A M) which sends b ⊗ m to (1 ⊗ b) ⊗ m for every b and m. Ring and module universes may differ with carriers in a common containing universe. No flatness is assumed.

proof.text: Identify the ring-hom-based restriction of B with B as an R-module by the identity additive equivalence, using Algebra.smul_def. TensorProduct.congr with the identity of M gives fT; tensor induction (zero, sum, pure tensor) proves B-linearity, giving fB on the scalar extension of the restricted module. Similarly identify A tensor_R B with its restriction along algebraMap A (A tensor_R B), tensor with M, and check B-linearity by induction using Algebra.smul_def, giving gB into the stated restricted scalar extension.

Take the inverse of Mathlib Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChange R B A (A tensor_R B) M, and compose fB, this equivalence, and gB. LinearEquiv.toModuleIso gives the required ModuleCat isomorphism. On b tensor m the two identity transports preserve pure tensors, and Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChange_symm_tmul gives includeRight b tensor m. This is the degreewise universal-property tensor cancellation in the unit route; no flatness is used.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_baseTensorOrdinaryDegreeIso
    (R : Type uR) (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (M : ModuleCat.{max uR uA uB v} A) :
    ∃ e :
      (extendScalars.{_, _, max uR uA uB v} (algebraMap R B)).obj
        ((restrictScalars.{max uR uA uB v} (algebraMap R A)).obj M) ≅
      (restrictScalars.{max uR uA uB v}
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).obj
        ((extendScalars.{_, _, max uR uA uB v}
          (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).obj M),
      ∀ (b : B) (m : M), e.hom (b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R B] m) =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight b ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)] m
